items.role: Software Engineer · Full Stack & AI Solutions
bullets: Designed and deployed Intelligent Document Processing (IDP) pipelines and RAG solutions with Qdrant to automate enterprise data extraction and enable contextual search.
Built and optimized scalable backend microservices with Spring Boot and PostgreSQL, and responsive interfaces with React (Redux/Saga) and Angular.
Automated end-to-end CI/CD pipelines with Azure DevOps, Jenkins and Docker, cutting deployment times and stabilizing every environment.
Run internal tech talks and mentor junior developers on Spring Boot, React and code quality.
Delivered a complete custom e-commerce platform for a health & wellness brand: storefront, checkout and a full admin back-office.
Dosage-based pricing, lab certificates per batch, stock by lot, coupons, refunds and automated order emails, covered by end-to-end tests.
Designed and implemented an automated functional testing framework to improve platform reliability.
Cut test execution time and sped up sprint delivery by introducing parallel test runs.
Built from scratch a web application to schedule and manage on-demand home service operations: bookings, technician assignment and live follow-up.
Developed a multi-tenant SaaS platform that lets restaurants create their own website, with Square payments and Uber Eats delivery integrated.

skills.title: What I reach for.

keys.@ai: Making documents and knowledge useful with AI.
keys.@backend: The engines behind the apps: reliable, fast, secure.
keys.@frontend: The part people see and touch.
keys.@qa: Proving it works before users have to.
keys.RAG: Lets an AI answer from your own documents instead of guessing.
keys.IDP: Turns piles of PDFs and scans into clean, usable data. My main work at Xelops.
keys.LLMs: Wiring language models into real products, not just demos.
keys.Embeddings: Search by meaning, not by exact words.
keys.Qdrant: The vector database behind my RAG search.
keys.AI agents: AI that works through steps on its own: reads, decides, uses tools.
keys.Java: My first language, and still my daily one.
keys.Spring Boot: The backbone of most services I’ve shipped.
keys.Python: For AI pipelines, scripts and quick experiments.
keys.FastAPI: Fast, clean APIs around AI models.
keys.REST APIs: How my apps talk to each other.
keys.Microservices: Splitting big systems into small parts that ship on their own.
keys.React: My go-to for interfaces people enjoy using.
keys.Next.js: React with speed and SEO built in.
keys.TypeScript: JavaScript that catches mistakes before users do.
keys.PostgreSQL: My default database: reliable and powerful.
keys.Redis: Caching, and anything that has to feel instant.
keys.AS400: Yes, legacy too: connecting modern apps to IBM systems.
keys.Kubernetes: Running and scaling containers in production.
keys.Azure DevOps: Pipelines that build, test and deploy on every change.
keys.GitLab CI: Pipelines living right next to the code.
keys.Playwright: Tests that click through the app like a real user.
keys.Cucumber: Tests written in plain language the whole team can read.
keys.Curiosity: The key I press the most. New tools, new ideas, every week.

answers.experience: Nearly 3 years: Software Engineer at Xelops Technology since Feb 2024 (full stack + AI solutions), an e-commerce platform built end to end for Lymit Labs, and internships at Neoxia, Saweblia and Tekcy.
answers.ai: I design Intelligent Document Processing pipelines (OCR + LLM extraction) and RAG solutions with the Qdrant vector database, running in production. I also built BrowseMate, a Chrome extension that brings LLMs to any web page.
answers.tech: Java & Spring Boot, Python (FastAPI, Flask), React and Angular, PostgreSQL, Qdrant, Redis, Docker, Kubernetes and Azure DevOps / Jenkins for CI/CD.
answers.open: Always happy to hear about interesting roles and projects, especially anything involving applied AI. The contact section is the fastest way to reach me.
answers.education: State Engineer's Degree in Software Engineering (2018–2023), plus certifications from AWS (Generative AI with Bedrock), Google (SRE), IBM and EdYoda.
